findings.fix: Change the text color to #666666 or darker to achieve at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio against light backgrounds.
findings.violation: Text color #999999 has insufficient contrast against the default light background, failing WCAG AA color contrast standards.

findings.fix: Change the label's for attribute to "topic" to match the select element's id.
findings.location: Section 3, form labels and controls (s3-form-topic-label, topic)
findings.violation: The label's for attribute references "topic-alt" but the select element has id="topic", creating a broken association.

findings.fix: Add aria-describedby="s3-form-promo-error" to the promo input element.
findings.violation: The input signals an error state but does not point to the error message element using aria-describedby.

findings.fix: Replace this with a semantic <button> element or add complete keyboard event handlers (Enter and Space keys).
findings.violation: A custom div element with role="button" requires full keyboard event handling and focus management that is not implemented.

findings.evidence: div class="wizard-steps" containing unlabeled step divs
findings.fix: Add role="region" and aria-label="Progress indicator" to s3-wizard, and add role="progressbar" or aria-current="step" to the active step.
findings.violation: The wizard steps container lacks semantic structure or ARIA landmarks to indicate it is a progress indicator.

findings.fix: Remove the overflow:hidden style or use overflow:auto to allow content to be accessible when text is enlarged.
findings.violation: The overflow:hidden style may hide important content from users who need to resize text or use zoom features.
